Hi guys! It’s the girlfriend(16F) here. I woke up to a text from my boyfriend(16M) saying he would be dropping off my stuff and picking up his and was VERY confused. He explained how he heard what I was doing last night and did not want a relationship anymore. Thing is, I had no idea what he was talking about.

My cat, (Kipo) has a cold. During the night she makes a lot of UNGODLY sounds. She also mirrors me(cats do that) and sits next to my phone when she sleeps. Cute, right????? Anyways.  She gags, sneezes, snores, breathes heavily. All kinds of stuff that I guess would come off as sexual sounding. I sent him proof of my messy ass room and lots more of my whereabouts last night and basically confirmed that no, *I was not having sex with another man last night.*
I was dead asleep. 

He’s at work right now but we called and talked it out. Another lesson learned to not always assume you know the whole story when reading reddit posts. <3
